mechanism: Both drugs can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities; tobramycin is nephrotoxic and alendronate requires careful renal monitoring, with potential for additive renal impairment and altered drug clearance.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if renal function is impaired or declining; separate dosing times and maintain upright position for alendronate.
